nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Gentle Skin Care Set for Dry Skin

avis.texte: I’ve been using this moisturizer consistently and it’s quickly become a staple in my daily routine. It strikes a really nice balance between hydration and a lightweight feel, which can be hard to find—especially if you don’t want something heavy or greasy. Texture & Application: The cream has a light, almost lotion-like texture that absorbs quickly into the skin. It doesn’t leave a sticky or oily residue, so it works well under makeup or sunscreen. A little goes a long way, and it spreads easily without needing to overapply. Hydration & Performance: It provides immediate hydration and keeps my skin feeling comfortable throughout the day. According to the brand, it helps repair the skin barrier within about an hour and offers up to 48 hours of hydration, which matches pretty closely with how it performs in real use. Ingredients & Skin Benefits: The inclusion of ceramides and niacinamide is a big plus. Ceramides help strengthen the skin barrier, while niacinamide is great for calming irritation and improving overall skin tone. It’s also fragrance-free, which makes it a solid option for sensitive skin or anyone trying to avoid irritation. Skin Type Compatibility: This worked well on my skin without causing breakouts or clogging pores. It’s marketed for all skin types, and I can see that being accurate—it’s hydrating enough for dry areas but still light enough for normal or combination skin. What I liked most: Lightweight but still very hydrating No fragrance or irritation Absorb

avis.titre: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Skincare Set, Excellent Hydration
avis.texte: I bought the La Roche-Posay Toleriane set, and I’m thrilled. The Double Repair Face Moisturizer is lightweight, non-greasy, and leaves my skin super soft. The hydrating cleanser is equally fantastic: it’s gentle, non-irritating, and cleanses my skin thoroughly.

The Toleraine Double Repair goes on so.smooth and lasts all day. I have not experienced a moisturizer that I feel actually works. After using this product for a couple of weeks, my face feels softer and smoother than it ever has. I have mature skin that is sensitive. I have had no problem with irritation what so ever. I will be buying this again and again.

avis.titre: Perfect for any kind of skin and non-greasy
avis.texte: Just recently switched to this moisturizer. I don’t like ones that are greasy and so when I read review, I was very upset by this. And it has not disappointed. I really enjoyed putting this song wanting you tonight. I feel my face is hydrated, but not greasy and a little goes along way.

avis.titre: You can’t miss with the luxuries skin care!
avis.texte: Great product I have Been using this product over a year now. It’s been soothing and keep my skin moisturized, Hood products for the skin and wallet.
Love this product and how it makes my face feel. It instantly puts moisture back into your face without feeling heavy.

avis.titre: Best lotion i have found since i got off Accutane!
avis.texte: I used to be on Accutane back in high school and I am now in my 20s. I have struggled with my face being very dry for years and not able to use a lot of lotions due to the harsh chemicals. This lotion has been a game changer for my skin, it is very lightweight and i cant feel it sitting on my face all day. Highly recommend if you have been on Accutane or just have dry skin!!!
Es la segunda vez que lo compro y me encantan, son perfectos para la piel grasa o las personas que tienen acné

This works very well for me. I have very dry/sensitive skin. I don’t really understand why they are giving you a small travel size face wash when the main product is a moisturizer. I was under the impression the “included travel size bottle” was going to be more moisturizer, but it’s face wash? It does specify it in the description about the face wash, so that was kinda my bad. One of my main selling points to this product was the travel sized bottle it comes with, so I was a little disappointed when it was soap. Overall good product, just beware the travel sized container is face wash

I have noticed many people really like the La Roche-Posay brand of skincare products in many of the beauty groups I am part of. I had not personally tried the La Roche-Posay products and I was curious, so when I saw this mild moisturizer I ordered it. I can say that the brand does seem to live up to the hype! This moisturizer is very gentle, which I love. It is unscented and only has a few key ingredients (see the photo I posted). It goes on very smooth and feels soothing. This is not the version with sunscreen, which I prefer. I like to do my own sunscreen as my last step (I recommend the Elta products for sunscreen). I definitely recommend this moisturizer for anyone with sensitive skin or who just wants a high-quality moisturizer. Also this package also contains a free travel-size La Roche-Posay facial cleanser, yay!

This cleanser and moisturizer set both have some nice skin-benefitting ingredients like glycerin, niacinamide, and ceramides without harsh ingredients that could irritate sensitive skin. They’re both fragrance free and gentle on the skin while providing excellent moisture and protecting the delicate skin barrier. The moisturizer is medium-weight with a lotion-like consistency. This would be good for me particularly in the summer as I am 48 and live in a Northern climate where a heavier face cream is usually a necessity. My skin enjoys this combo, and while I have not noticed any earth-shattering results, this set does a good job and keeping it simple yet effective when it comes to making skin happy. Highly recommended for ALL skin types.

I love these two products: one being the lotion and the other being the face wash. The face wash is gently on my sensitive skin - it reminds me of Cetaphil, but feels better. My face gets oily from working in a kitchen all day so I like to wash after work and so far I haven’t had any issues with this product. The lotion is amazing as well - it comes out thick, but goes on smooth with no greasy residue. I use both products daily and as I mentioned haven’t had issues even though I have sensitive skin. Highly recommend!
La crema grande la recibi sin ningun sello en la tapa que indicara q no habia sido abierta. La pequeña si la tiene.
5.07oz is the total volume of the moisturizer and cleanser combined, NOT the moisturizer alone.

One thing I really like about this product is its packaging - it comes in a convenient squeeze tube. While the cleanser is good, the moisturizer is outstanding. It's lightweight and scent-free, and absorbs quickly, leaving a smooth finish.

Both products came with a tamper proof seal and generous expiration dates. The cleanser is something between a gel and a cream. It doesn't lather (not a problem), and it left my face feeling clean, soft, and smooth. The moisturizer is a favorite. No discernible scent. Absorbs really well and doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky or greasy. I might opt for a heavier mositurizer in the driest winter months but this is a go-to choice for the rest of the year. I only wish it had sunscreen!

This is my 3rd or 4th purchase of La Roche-Posay Double Repair moisturizer. The moisturizing effect is perfect. Niacinamide and ceramides make my skin look and feel healtier. I wish there is SPF in it but it's still a good day and night moisturizer. The moisturizer in the set is in full size and the cleanser is travel size. Cleanser cream is gentle but effective. Great duo.
